description: Connect RSS or Atom feeds to the workspace, up to 100 at a time (the workspace reads at most 500): each url is a feed's address, or a page's (a forum, a community, a blog) whose advertised feed is used. Every keyword reading workspace feeds then gets the feed's items holding its term, polled every hour; reading a feed is free, its matches bill like any mention. Each { url } is checked on its own and reported added, already (the workspace reads it) or failed with an error code: feed_unreadable (no feed found, or the site blocks automated readers), feed_login_required (a members-only forum: send it again as { url, auth: { type: "cookie", value } } with the person's own sign-in, stored encrypted and read for this workspace alone), feed_login_expired, feed_limit_reached. The first 8 added bring each keyword the newest 10 matching items of the last 30 days.

feeds.description: Up to 100 feeds, each { url } or { url, auth } for a members-only one. Each is checked on its own: one that fails never stops the others.

items.description: One feed to connect, with a sign-in when it is members-only.

value.description: The Cookie header your browser sends to the forum (devtools, Network, the feed's request, Request Headers, cookie).

name.description: The header name, e.g. Api-Key (Discourse) or Authorization.

auth.description: A sign-in for a members-only feed: a cookie, or one header. Write-only: stored encrypted, sent to the feed's own site alone, never shown again. A feed with a sign-in is read for this workspace alone.

url.description: A feed's address (https://forum.example.com/posts.rss), or a page's (https://forum.example.com): the feed the page advertises is used.

name: add_feeds
title: Add feeds
